content.body:
Facing the rapid introduction of the semi-automatic rifles of the United States and the U.S.S.R - the M1 Garand and the Tokarev SVT-40, respectively - Germany sought out an answer which became the Gewehr 43.
More difficult to produce, it was not issued in quantities approaching its rivals but over 400,000 were fielded by the end of the war.
content.brief: WEAPON: Gewehr 43 AMMO: 8x57mm IS MAGAZINE: 10 rounds MUZZLE VELOCITY: 755 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Semi-automatic OTHER EQUIPMENT: StiG 24 HE Grenades (4) NbHgn 39 Smoke Grenades (2) Combat Knife Ammo Resupply Pack
